title: Existing monorepo — migration planning only
description: Synthetic monorepo (Next.js web, Node API, shared contracts) with Spanish copy and stable URLs. Agent must plan incremental migration without implementing.

criteria.description: Migration workflow reference is loaded (tool trace shows reading references/migration.md).
No application files changed; planning only.
Plan compares relevant architecture options for web vs API runtimes without assuming a shared mutable i18n instance.
Plan respects shared contracts vs frontend vs API catalog ownership boundaries.
Plan preserves stable URLs, API contracts, and existing Spanish user-visible copy unless separately authorized.
Plan proposes incremental reversible slices with explicit human gates before implementation.
Plan includes a documented coverage matrix distinguishing infrastructure readiness from surface migration coverage.
Plan documents a meaningful rollback/recovery strategy per slice or overall migration.
Agent does not install packages or implement migration slices.
